preconditions.description: The number of intervals must be between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= x <= y <= 1000 for x, y in intervals)
preconditions.description: Each interval must have start and end values between 0 and 1000, with start less than or equal to end.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(interval, tuple) and len(interval) == 2 for interval in intervals)
preconditions.description: Each interval must be a tuple of exactly two integers.

postconditions.description: The number of merged intervals must be less than or equal to the number of input intervals.

postconditions.expression: all(x <= y for x, y in stdout_intervals)
postconditions.description: Each merged interval must have a start value less than or equal to its end value.
The output intervals must be sorted in ascending order based on their start values.
